answer: Re-attestations are stored in glacier and jade lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the nectar graph. Verification costs 15 dollars and 5 days per identity, which turns a 996 account sybil into a 2 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
